第一章 大姐，我想这是个误会（四）

[[[CP|W:300|H:300|A:L|U:chapters/201011/29/]]]继续求推荐票、求点击。其实我有点想哭，酒神和天珠变一同上了推荐榜，还相互挨着。如果都集中在一本书上，我们的推荐榜位置就第二了。尝试着发张图片，这是红宝石，以后小三会将书里出现的宝石都发图给大家，并且进行简单介绍。红宝石就不用多说了吧，大家都很熟悉。

－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－

“公主殿下，不可。”尼雅惊呼一声，想要阻拦帝芙雅，可此时的她却已经愤怒到了极点，右手一拦尼雅，左手已经朝着周维清的方向抬了起来。

尼雅虽然是上位体师，但她的天力修为是天精力九重，比帝芙雅只高两重，在不使用体珠的情况下又投鼠忌器不敢过于动用天力，顿时被帝芙雅抬起的右手阻拦了一下，也就在这短暂的工夫，帝芙雅已经完成了对周维清的攻击。

帝芙雅左手手腕上第一枚红宝石意珠光芒绽放，一团人头大小的火球呼啸而出，在天空中带起一道炫丽的尾焰狠狠的砸在了周维清背上。火球轰然炸开，周维清惨叫一声，整个人被炸飞出五米外，再狠狠的落在地上，接连翻滚几周，背后已是血肉模糊中还带着一股焦味儿。

“你、你……”他勉强抬起头，看向出手后也同样陷入呆滞的帝芙雅，他怎么也没想到，帝芙雅竟然真的会对他出手，而且是如此狠辣。

帝芙雅脸色一片苍白，在愤怒中爆发后，她也立刻意识到了不妙，自己第一意珠拓印的爆裂火球威力如何她清楚的很，一时间，顿时心神俱颤，不论怎么说，周维清都是帝国元帅之子，可现在她就算后悔也已经晚了。

身为帝芙雅贴身侍卫的尼雅也呆住了，贴身内依瞬间就被冷汗浸透了，要是公主殿下杀了元帅之子，刚出生时就被赐予子爵爵位的周维清，恐怕就要帝国大乱了。可是，她和帝芙雅都不擅长治疗，此时二女都已经是一片茫然的不知所措。

就在这时候，突然间，原本还是一片晴朗的天空骤然阴沉下来，一声炸雷在星辰森林上空响起，紧接着，整个天空在几次呼吸的工夫中就已经变得漆黑如墨。帝芙雅和尼雅都感觉到一股冰冷寒意莫名的出现在自己心中。

“我、我不是故意的。”帝芙雅喃喃的说道。

尼雅此时也已经醒悟过来，一把拉住帝芙雅道：“公主殿下，天色不对，我们赶快走，先回皇宫再说，找位生命系意师来救周子爵。”说着，她用力拉扯着帝芙雅扭头就跑。她很清楚，周维清这么个普通人被帝芙雅用意珠拓印技能正面轰中，活下来的可能微乎其微，这个时候，必须要先离开现场再说，否则，一旦被别人看到，那就真的完了。先离开这里才是最正确的选择，火系意珠师在天弓帝国虽然不多，但也绝不只是帝芙雅公主一人，只要不在现场，一切都还有转圜余地。

周维清躺在地上，全身虽是动弹不得，但他却清楚的听着帝芙雅和尼雅离开的脚步声。此时此刻，他只觉得自己全身似乎都浸入了熔岩地狱一般，体内的血液似乎都沸腾了，每一次张口，都有淡红色的雾气从口中喷出。被爆裂火球正面轰击的背部并不疼痛，因为早已是完全麻木了，但那炽热的火毒却在侵蚀着他身体的每一部分，如果在刚刚被帝芙雅攻击后能够有一位生命系的意珠师救助，或许他还有活下来的机会，但此时，火毒已经侵入肺腑，生命正在一点一滴的远离他而去。

周维清本是个天性十分乐观的人，否则的话，他身为元帅之子却是个无法修炼的普通人，也不可能过的这么舒心了。他不想死，一点都不想死，他还有很多想做的事情没有去做。他无论如何也想不到，自己竟然会要死在未婚妻手中。其实，他心中并不是特别恨帝芙雅，他只恨上天为什么不给他一个能够修炼的身体，如果他也能够成为一名御珠师，那么，一切都会不一样。强烈的怨念犹如实质一般不断的从周维清身上散发而出，他在心中恶狠狠的发誓：“帝芙雅，如果老子这次能够不死，总有一天，我会让你跪在我面前，求我娶你。然后我再将你弃之如敝履。”

发完这最后的誓言，周维清的意识已经开始渐渐模糊了，就连那无比灼热的感觉也已经越来越淡，我的生命真的就要这么结束了么？这是他心中最后的想法。

正在这时，突然间，轰隆一声巨响，一声轰鸣就像是在他头顶上出现了个炸雷似的，将半昏迷状态的周维清又震的暂时清醒过来，他瞪大了双眼，看到的，是一副无比诡异的画面。

一道黑色裂缝，就出现在他面前三尺外的空中，空气宛如一只巨大的眼睛，悄然向两旁撕裂开来，因为之前的剧烈轰鸣，周维清被震荡的已是张大了嘴，又是一口淡红色的血雾从口中喷吐而出。

也就在这个时候，那黑色裂缝之中，一团奇异的光彩就像是那巨大黑眸的瞳孔一般悄然出现，那是一个球状体，有婴儿拳头大小，本体漆黑如墨，但上面却渲染着青、蓝、银三色光彩。周维清那一口血雾正好喷在了这枚妖异的黑珠之上。顿时，一股周维清从未感受过的极致冰冷气息瞬间就从那黑色的珠子上爆发开来，瞬间冲入周维清体内。

周维清的身体剧烈颤抖起来，之前的所有灼热和灼烧感一瞬间就已是荡然无存，他只觉得自己如坠冰窖一般，原本已经有些迷糊的情绪在这一刻突然变得异常亢奋起来，周围的一切也在他的六感之中变得格外清晰。

那枚黑色的珠子仿佛被他身体中什么力量牵引着一般，嗖的一下，直接钻入了他口中，周维清只觉得嗓子眼一凉，全身就像是变成了冰雕一般，所有意识已经被瞬间封闭，眼前一黑，就昏了过去。

周维清身体上方的裂缝悄然闭合，紧接着，前一刻还漆黑如墨的天空平静了下来，如墨的乌云缓缓散去，阳光又一次降临在星辰森林，当然，也降临在那冰泉小湖之上。

[[[CP|W:300|H:300|A:L|U:chapters/201011/29/]]]Continue to ask for recommendation votes and clicks.In fact, I feel like crying. Dionysus and Dzi Bead Transformation are both on the recommendation list, next to each other.If they were all concentrated on one book, it would be ranked second on our recommendation list.Try to send a picture, this is a ruby. In the future, Xiaosan will send pictures of all the gems that appear in the book to everyone, and give a brief introduction.There is no need to say more about ruby, everyone is familiar with it.

-----------------------------------------------------------

"Your Highness, no." Niya exclaimed, wanting to stop Difuya, but at this time she was extremely angry. She blocked Niya with her right hand and raised her left hand in the direction of Zhou Weiqing.

Although Niya is a high-level physical master, her Heavenly Power cultivation is at the ninth level of Heavenly Energy, which is only two levels higher than Difuya. Without using the body beads, she cast a rat weapon and did not dare to use her heavenly power too much. She was immediately blocked by Difuya's raised right hand. In this short time, Difuya had completed the attack on Zhou Weiqing.

The first ruby ​​gemstone on Difuya's left wrist bloomed with light, and a fireball the size of a human head roared out, bringing up a dazzling tail flame in the sky and hitting Zhou Weiqing hard on the back.The fireball exploded with a bang, and Zhou Weiqing screamed. His whole body was blown five meters away, and he landed hard on the ground. He rolled for several weeks, and his back was covered in blood and flesh with a burning smell.

"You, you..." He reluctantly raised his head and looked at Difuya, who was also stunned after the attack. He never expected that Difuya would actually take action against him, and be so cruel.

Difuya's face turned pale. After she burst out in anger, she immediately realized that something was wrong. She knew very well how powerful the explosive fireball of her first Yi Bead rubbing was. For a moment, her heart was trembling. No matter what, Zhou Weiqing was the son of the Imperial Marshal, but now it was too late for her to regret it.

Niya, who was Difuya's personal bodyguard, was also stunned, and her inner body was instantly soaked in cold sweat. If Her Royal Highness the Princess killed Zhou Weiqing, the marshal's son who was given the title of Viscount at birth, the empire would probably be in chaos.However, neither she nor Difuya was good at treatment, and both women were at a loss at this time.

At this moment, suddenly, the originally clear sky suddenly became gloomy, a thunder sounded over the star forest, and then, the entire sky became as dark as ink in a few breaths.Both Divya and Niya felt an icy coldness appear inexplicably in their hearts.

"I, I didn't mean it." Divya murmured.

Niya had also come to her senses at this time. She grabbed Difuya and said, "Your Highness, the weather is not right. Let's leave quickly and go back to the palace first. We will find a life master to save Viscount Zhou." As she said this, she pulled Difuya hard and ran away.She knew very well that if an ordinary person like Zhou Weiqing was hit head-on by Difuya's mind bead rubbing skill, the chance of surviving was very slim. At this time, he had to leave the scene first, otherwise, if he was seen by others, it would be really over.Leaving here first is the most correct choice. Although there are not many fire-type Yiju masters in the Tiangong Empire, Princess Difuya is by no means the only one. As long as they are not present, there is still room for change.

Zhou Weiqing was lying on the ground, unable to move, but he could clearly hear the footsteps of Difuya and Niya leaving.At this moment, he felt as if his whole body was immersed in a lava hell, and the blood in his body seemed to be boiling. Every time he opened his mouth, light red mist spurted out of his mouth.The back that was hit by the explosive fireball didn't hurt because he was already completely numb, but the hot fire poison was eroding every part of his body. If he could have been rescued by a life-type Yiju Master just after being attacked by Difuya, he might still have a chance to survive. But at this time, the fire poison had invaded his heart, and life was leaving him bit by bit.

Zhou Weiqing is a very optimistic person by nature. Otherwise, as the son of a marshal, he is an ordinary person who cannot practice, and he would not be able to live such a comfortable life.He doesn't want to die, not at all, and there are still many things he wants to do that he hasn't done yet.He never imagined that he would die at the hands of his fiancée.In fact, he didn't particularly hate Difuya in his heart. He only hated God for not giving him a body that could cultivate. If he could also become a bead master, everything would be different.Strong resentment continued to emanate from Zhou Weiqing like substance, and he swore viciously in his heart: "Difuya, if I can survive this time, one day, I will let you kneel in front of me and beg me to marry you. Then I will abandon you like a worn-out shoe."

After making this last vow, Zhou Weiqing's consciousness began to gradually blur, and even the burning feeling became weaker and weaker. Is my life really going to end like this?This was the last thought in his mind.

At this moment, suddenly, there was a loud bang, a roar like a thunderclap above his head, jolting the semi-conscious Zhou Weiqing back to consciousness temporarily. His eyes widened, and what he saw was an extremely strange scene.

A black crack appeared in the air three feet away in front of him. The air was like a huge eye, quietly tearing open to both sides. Because of the previous violent roar, Zhou Weiqing was so shaken that he opened his mouth wide, and another mouthful of light red blood mist spat out from his mouth.

At this time, in the black crack, a group of strange brilliance quietly appeared like the pupil of the huge black eye. It was a spherical body, the size of a baby's fist. Its body was as black as ink, but it was filled with cyan, blue, and silver colors.Zhou Weiqing's blood mist sprayed right on this strange black bead.Suddenly, an extremely cold aura that Zhou Weiqing had never felt before instantly burst out from the black beads and rushed into Zhou Weiqing's body.

Zhou Weiqing's body trembled violently, and all the previous burning and burning sensations disappeared in an instant. He felt like he was falling into an ice cellar. His already somewhat confused emotions suddenly became extremely excited at this moment, and everything around him became extremely clear to his six senses.

The black bead seemed to be pulled by some force in his body, and with a swish, it penetrated directly into his mouth. Zhou Weiqing felt a chill in his throat, and his whole body seemed to have turned into an ice sculpture. All consciousness was instantly closed, and his vision went dark, and he fainted.

The crack above Zhou Weiqing's body quietly closed, and then, the sky that was as dark as ink a moment ago calmed down, the ink-like dark clouds slowly dispersed, and the sun once again fell on the star forest, and of course, also on the icy spring lake.
